copy.tagline: 发现并导航 GKE 集群核心信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果日常需要查看和管理 Google Kubernetes Engine 集群
copy.tagline_en: Discover and navigate core GKE cluster info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly need to view and manage Google Kubernetes Engine clusters

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能够回答关于 Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) 的基础问题，比如创建集群、管理节点等。它还会根据你的具体需求，自动推荐更专业的子技能来处理网络、安全等高级任务。
howto.when: 当你询问 GKE 相关的基础操作或概念时触发，例如创建集群、获取凭证等。对于纯知识性问题（如“什么是 GKE？”），Claude 会直接回答而不执行命令。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 GKE 集群，使用 Autopilot 模式。
say.note: Claude 会提供创建命令或指导。

say.text: 如何获取 GKE 集群的凭证？
say.note: Claude 会解释 get-credentials 命令。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to answer basic questions about Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), such as creating clusters and managing nodes. It also routes to specialized sub-skills for advanced tasks like networking or security based on your needs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about basic GKE operations or concepts, e.g., creating a cluster or getting credentials. For purely conceptual questions (e.g., 'What is GKE?'), Claude answers directly without executing commands.

say_en.text: Create a GKE cluster in Autopilot mode.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the command or guidance.

say_en.text: How do I get credentials for my GKE cluster?
